description: Rules for recording why a manually marked math_block may need image rendering in WeChat Mini Program.

matchers.name: sqrt
matchers.reason: Square roots can look poor in Mini Program rendering.

matchers.name: vector
matchers.reason: Vector notations can be unstable in Mini Program rendering.

matchers.name: dfrac
matchers.reason: Display fractions can be misaligned or too small.

matchers.name: aligned
matchers.reason: Multi-line aligned equations often need image rendering.

matchers.name: cases
matchers.reason: Piecewise structures are good candidates for image rendering.

matchers.name: matrix
matchers.reason: Matrix layouts are good candidates for image rendering.

matchers.name: sum_or_integral
matchers.reason: Optional future rule for sum and integral.
